summary: REV-2 fixed: the per-app fold map moved back into Sidebar (useState + useCallback toggle) so the collapsed rail branch no longer discards it; SidebarProjects now receives `collapsed` and `onToggleCollapsed` as props. Added a regression test pinning that a folded app stays folded after collapsing and expanding the pane. The stable useCallback keeps SidebarProjects memoised so a tab switch still does not reconcile the 500-row list.
